m: 1. अपस् n. (fr. 1. अप्), work, action, especially sacred act, sacrificial act, RV.[Lat. opus.]
2. अपस् mfn. active, skilful in any art, RV.
अपस् (असस्), f. pl. N. of the hands and fingers (when employed in kindling the sacred fire and in performing the sacrifices), RV.
of the three goddesses of sacred speech, RV.; VS.
of the active or running waters, RV.; AV.

3. अपस् mfn. (fr. 2. अप्), watery. (So some passages of the Ṛg-veda [i, 95, 4, &c.] may (according to NBD. and others) be translated where the word is applied to the running waters See 2. अपस् at end and अपस्-तम.)
a: अपस् — n. [आप् असुन् थस्वश्च; आपःकर्माख्यायां थस्वो नुट्च वा स्यात् Uṇ. 4. 207. अप्नः, अपः] 1 Work, action; अपसा संतु नेमे Rv. 1. 54. 8. --2 Sacred act or rite, sacrificial work. --3 Water. --a. (अपाः) 1 Active, engaged in any act (कर्मयुक्त). --2 Got or obtained. According to B. and R. अपसः f. pl. stands in the Veda for (1) the hands and fingers busy in kindling the sacred fire and performing the sacrificial rites; (2) the three goddesses of sacred speech or the three divinities, fire, wind and sun; and (3) the active or running waters. [cf. L. opus.]

To the right, making the sacred thread hang down towards the left part of the body over the right shoulder (opp. सव्यं when it hangs over the left); a position of the thread in Śrāddha or other religious ceremonies at particular times of those ceremonies (the three positions being सव्य, निवीत & अपसव्य) Ms. 3. 279; ˚व्यं कृ to go round one so as to keep the right side towards him; to make the sacred thread hang over the right shoulder.

a: अपसृ — {c1c} P. 1 To walk off, go or get away, depart; अपसर इतः begone, avaunt, hence, get you gone; अपसराग्रतः Pt. 1. --2 To withdraw, retire, retreat, turn back; यदपसरति मेषः कारणं तत्प्रहर्तुं Pt. 3. 43. --3 To vanish, disappear; यस्यानुष्ठानेन मे संततिविनाशदुःखमपसरति Pt. 1. --4 To escape, elude the sight. --Caus. To make (a thing or person) go away or retire, take or put away, remove, drive away or off, throw aside; अपसारय घनसारं K. P. 9; अपसार्यतां वेत्रलता Pt. 1 put aside, take away; Ms. 7. 149.

m: अप-√ सृप् to glide or move off; to retreat.

To drive away or off.

m: अप-सृप्ति f. going away from (abl.)

v: apasmAra

pu॰ apasmArayati smaraRaM vilopayati apa + smfRic--karttari ac, apagataH smAraH smaraRaMyato vA । 1 rogaBede । sa ca suSrute darSito yaTA “smftirBUtArTavijYAnamapaSca parivarjane apasmAra iti proktastato'yaM vyADirantakft ॥ miyyAdiyogendriyArTakarmmaRAmatisevanAt । virudDamalinAhAravihArakupitErmalEH । veganigrahaSIlAnAmahitASuciBojinAm । rajastamo'BiBUtAnAM gacCatAYca rajasvalAm ॥ taTA kAmaBayodvegakroDaSokAdiBirBfSam । cetasyaBihate pumsAmapasmAro'BijAyate ॥ saMjYAvahezu srotaHsu dozavyAptezu mAnavaH । rajastamaHparItezumUQo BrAntena cetasA ॥ vikzipan hastapAdO ca vijihvaBrUrvilocanaH । dantAn vAdan vaman PenaM vivftAkzaH patet kzitO ॥ alpakAlAntaraYcApi punaH saMjYAM laBeta saH । so'pasmAra iti proktaH sa ca dfzwaScaturviDaH ॥ vAtapittakaPErnFRAYcaturTaH sannipAtataH । hftkampaH SUnyatA svedoDyAnaM mUrcCA pramUQatA ॥ nidrAnASaSca tasmiMstu Bavizyati BavantyaTa । vepamAno daSeddantAn Svasan PenaM vamannapi ॥ yo brUyAdvikftaM satvaM kfzRaM mAmanuDAvati । tato me cittanASaH syAtso'pasmAro'nilAtmakaH ॥ tfwtApasvedamUrcCArttoDvanannaNgAni vihvalaH । yo brUyAdvikftaM satvaM pItaM mAmanuDAvati ॥ tato me cittanASaH syAtsa pittaBava ucyate । SItahfllAsanidrArttaH patan BUmO vaman kaPam ॥ yo brUyAdvikftaM satvaM SuklaM mAmanuDAvati । tato me cittanASaH yAtso'pasmAraH kaPAtmakaH ॥ hfdi todastfqutkledastrizvapyetezu saMsTayA । pralApaH kUjanaM kleSaH pratyekantu Bavediha ॥ sarvvaliNgasamAvAyaH sarvvadozaprakopaje । animittAgamAdvyADergamanAdakfte'pi ca ॥ AgamAccApyapasmAraM vadantyanye na dozajam kramopayogAddozARAM kzaRikatvAttaTEva ca ॥ AgamAdvESvarUpyAcca sa tu nirvarRyate buDEH । varzatyapi yaTA deve BUmO vIjAni kAnicit ॥ Saradi pratirohanti taTA vyADisamudBavaH । sTAyinaH kecidalpena kAlenABipravardDitAH ॥ darSayanti vikArAMstu viSvarUpAnnisargataH । apasmAro mahAvyADistasmAddozaja eva tu” iti ॥ “DUrtto'pasmArarogI syAditi” SAtA॰ karmma॰ । “apasmArAdirogARAM jvarAdInAM viSezata iti” Gawukastotram ।
m: अप-स्मार m. epilepsy, falling sickness, Suśr. &c.
want of memory, confusion of mind (in rhet. one of the Vyabhicāribhāvas, q.v.), Sāh.
a: अपस्मारः, --स्मृतिः — f. [अपस्मारयति स्मरणं विलोपयति, स्मृ-णिच्, कर्तरि अच्, or अपगतः स्मारः स्मरणं यतः] 1 Forgetfulness, loss of memory; स्मर˚ Bh. 1. 89. --2 Epilepsy, falling sickness; Suśr. thus derives it; स्मृतिर्भूतार्थविज्ञानमपश्च परिवर्जने . अपस्मार इति प्रोक्तस्ततोयं व्याधिरंतकृत् ..

v: apasmArin
tri॰ apasmAra + astyarTe ini । 1 apasmAraroga yukte । striyAM NIp ।
m: अप-स्मारिन् mfn. epileptic, convulsed, Mn. &c.
a: अपस्मारिन् — a. Epileptic, having an epileptic fit; Ms. 3. 7; Śi. 3. 72.

m: अप-स्मय mfn. free from arrogance or pride, BhP.
अप-स्मृति mfn. forgetful, BhP.
absent in mind, confused, ib.
a: अपस्मृति — a. Forgetful.

impure water in which a person has previously washed, Mn. iv, 132.
a: अपस्नानं — 1 Bathing as after mourning or upon the death of a relative; funeral bathing. --2 Impure bathing, bathing in water in which a person has previously washed himself (स्नानशिष्टं जलं) Ms. 4. 132.

a: अपस्नात — a. [अपकृष्टं स्नातः] One who has bathed after death or mourning or upon the death of a relation, preparatory to other ceremonies.

k.v: भरण्यभुक्कर्मकरः कर्मकारस्तु तत्क्रियः। अपस्नातो मृतस्नात आमिषाशी तु शौष्कुलः॥

अपस्पर्श — a. Insensible.

m: अपस्—पति m. N. of a son of Uttānapāda, VP.
अपस्-पति See 2. अपस्.
अप-√ स्पृ Ā. (impf. 3. pl. -स्पृण्वत) to extricate from, deliver from, KauṣBr.; (3. pl. -स्पृण्वते) to refresh [Gmn.; ‘to alienate’, BR.], RV. viii, 2, 5.

a: अपस्पृश् — a. Ved. Not letting oneself be touched.
अपस्तंभः — A vessel in the side of the breast containing vital air.

m: अप-स्तम्भ m. id., Suśr.
अप-स्तम्भिनी f. N. of a plant.

most rapid, RV. x, 75, 7.
अपस्-तम See 2. अपस्.
a: अपस्तम — a. Most active or rapid.

m: अप-स्तम्ब m. a vessel inside or on one side of the chest containing vital air, Bhpr.
अपस्तन mfn. far from the mother's breast, MBh.
अप-स्वान m. a hurricane, Āp.
अप-स्वर m. an unmusical note or sound, L.
अप-स्वर mfn. singing out of tune, Saṃgīt.
a: अपस्वरः — An unmusical sound or note.

m: 1. अपस्या f. activity, RV. v, 44, 8; vii, 45, 2 (cf. स्व्-अपस्या; for 2. अपस्या, see 2. अपस्य below.)
2. अपस्या f. a kind of brick (twenty are used in building the sacrificial altar), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

v: apasya

tri॰ apasi kammaRi sADuH apas + yat । 1 sADukarmmakAriRi “anAvfzwA apasyovasAnA” iti “yaju॰ 10, 7, apasyAH apasi karmaRi sADvyaH” ve॰ dI॰ । “apareRa svayamAtfRRametyApasyAH paYca paYcAnUkAntezvapAmiti” kA॰ 17, 6, 2, apasyAstatsaMjYakA izwakABedA iti vedadI॰ ।
m: 1. अपस्य Nom. P. (Subj. ˚स्यात्) to be active, RV. i, 121, 7.
2. अपस्य mf(सी)n. watery, melting, dispersing, RV. x, 89, 2; VS. x, 7
अपस्य , अपस्यु. See अपस्.
a: अपस्य — a. [अपसि कर्मणि साधुः यत्] Ved. Active, fit for an act, skilful in doing any thing (साधुकर्मकारिन्); Yv. 10. 7; flowing, watery. --स्या 1 Activity. --2 Water. --3 A sort of brick used in preparing the sacrificial altar.
अपस्य, --स्यु — &c. See under अपस्.
अपस्यति — Den. P. To be active.

m: अपस्यु mfn. active, RV.
a: अपस्यु — a. [अपस्-क्यच्-उ] Active, busily engaged, desirous of working.
